amendments.summary: After NA-E026 missed its split-2021 law gate by 0.0013 (excess -25.8% vs -30%), the identical NA-E026 config is confirmed on splits 42 and 2024. Decision rule fixed BEFORE these runs: KEEP the degradation-law loss only if (i) the 3-split mean MAPE is <= parent 0.1087 + 0.005 and (ii) the 3-split mean held-out law-fit excess over the true-EOL floor falls >= 30% vs the parent's 3-split mean excess, and (iii) balance PASS on every split. Reported transparently as an amendment, not as the original pre-registration.

Main-loss ablation: train the best Na model (NA-E009 config) with MSE on the standardised EOL (the paper's CPMLP loss) instead of Relative Huber, 3 splits (NA-E029/E030/E031), no physics term, to measure how MAPE changes. Diagnostic only; it cannot replace the frozen model unless the user decides.

Physics gate relaxed by the user AFTER seeing the N1 results: a physics loss passes if its held-out physics metric decreases (any reduction) instead of the pre-registered 20% (N1) / 30% (A5) reduction; MAPE ceiling and balance PASS on every split remain. Must be reported in the thesis as a post-hoc user decision.
